rows.grounds: bodily winds as objects of destruction
first member specifying type of disease

items.question: Which specific winds and diseases are claimed to be eliminated by this prescribed practice?
premises: Both eliminations are presented as effects of the same practice.
items.inference: The prescribed practice removes eighty bodily winds and the disease of leprosy.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eighty winds depends on the broader medical or yogic context.
items.plain_english: It destroys the eighty winds, and indeed destroys the disease of leprosy.
